build_block_tables: build a BlockTables instance to manage GPU KV cache block tables with configurable block sizes and context parallelism
create_append_block_ids: create block table entries by appending block IDs for a given request with optional overwrite behavior
test_gather_block_tables: test the gather_block_tables method to copy block tables from staged writes to input tensors using an index mapping
review_compute_slot_mappings: review the compute_slot_mappings method to compute GPU slot mappings from positions and block tables with context parallelism support
summarize_apply_staged_writes: summarize the apply_staged_writes method to commit staged block table writes and copy num_blocks to UVA memory
